content: Enshobôlo z’Israheli
Ndesire okuli muli Kristu, ntabesha, n’omurhima gwâni ye muhamîrizi wâni muli Mûka Mutagatîfu:
ngwêrhe burhè bunji n’amababale garhahusa omu murhima.
Nêci, nankasîmire niene nkagwe nnantenzibwekwo Kristu erhi bene wîrhu bàrhuma, balya b’omu ishanja lyâni ly’omubiri;
bo bene-Israheli: bo Nyamuzinda acîshozire mpu babè bâna bâge anayêrakane irenge lyâge muli bo; bo bahîrwe endagâno n’amarhegeko n’emigenzo y’okukolera Nyamuzinda n’eciragâne câge.
Bashakulûza bâli b’omu ishanja lyâbo; n’oku maburhwa g’omubiri, Kristu ali wa kuli bo, ye mwâmi mukulu w’ebintu byoshi, ye Nyamuzinda mugishe emyâka n’emyâka. Amen!
Nyamuzinda arhagalula akanwa kâge
Arhali kuderha oku akanwa ka Nyamuzinda kakubire; bulya arhali ababurhagwa n’Israheli boshi bo bene-Israheli,
arhanali abarhengaga omu nda y’Abrahamu boshi bo bâna bâge; ci kuli Izaki iburha lyâwe lyârhenza izîno;
kwo kuderha oku abâna b’omubiri arhali bo bâna ba Nnâmahanga, ci abâna b’eciragâne bône lyo iburha ly’okuli.
Yumvagi oku eciragâne cidesire: Hano nshub’igera mw’aga mango, erhi Sara agwêrhe omwâna w’oburhabâna.
Arhanali okwôla kwône. Rebeka naye arhôzire izîmi lya mulume muguma yêne, ye larha Izaki.
Erhi abâna babà barhaj’iburhwa, barhaj’ijira oli ecinjà oli ecibî, mpu lyo Nnâmahanga ayêrekana oku ajira nk’oku alonzize omu kucîshoga abâge,
oku arhalola bijiro, ci bulonza bw’owahamagala yêne, anacibwirwa, mpu: Enfula yanashiga omuziba,
nk’oku biyandisirwe mpu: Narhonyize Yakôbo, nashomba Ezau. Nyamuzinda anahash’ijira nk’oku alonzize
Kurhi rhwaderhaga? Ka Nyamuzinda ankabamwo obulyâlya? Ntà mango!
Kali yêne wabwîraga Mûsa, erhi: Mbabalira oyu nnonzize okubabalira, nnambera lukogo oyu nnonzize okubêra lukogo.
Kuziga birhali bya kulonza erhi bya kulibirha kwa muntu, ci bya bwonjo bwa Nnâmahanga.
Kandi Amandiko gàbwizire Faraoni mwâmi w’e Mîsiri, erhi: Nakuyimikaga nti nkuyêrekanemwo obuhashe bwâni, lyo n’izîno lyâni likuzibwa omu igulu lyoshi.
Ntyôla, anababalire oyu alonzize, n’oyu alonzize okudundaguza amudundaguze.
Okolaga wambwîra, erhi: «Cirhuma acicîduduma? Ndi wankalahira okujira ebi alonzize?»
We muntu, oligi ndi mpu wajîsa Nyamuzinda kadali? K’akantu omuntu abumbaga kankamubwîra, erhi: «Carhumaga wanjira ntya?»
K’omubumbi arhankakolêsa ibumba lyâge nk’oku alonzize, n’okurhenza mw’eryo ibumba liguma akantu kinjinja n’akantu ka ntyantya?
Naye Nnâmahanga, omu kuyêrekana obukunizi bwâge n’okumanyîsa obuhashe bwâge, akabà alêmbîre n’obutûdu bunji ebiremwa bikwânîne obukunizi byàli hôfi h’okuberereka,
akabà alonzize okuyêrekana obuhirhi bw’obukuze bwâge oku biremwa by’olukogo yêne ali ayôsire arheganyîze obukuze.
N’ebyo biremwa by’olukogo byo rhwe ahamagalaga, arhali omu Buyahudi bône, ci n’omu bapagani.
Kwo adesire omu kanwa ka Hozeya, erhi
: Nayîrika lubaga lwâni abarhâli lubaga lwâni, na murhonyi wâni orhàli murhonyi;
n’aha babwîriragwa, mpu: Murhali lubaga lwâni, abo bônene baderhwe bene Nyamuzinda ozîne.
Naye Izaya aderhîre Israheli, erhi: ciru bene-Israheli bankaluga nka mushenyi gw’omu nyanja, obusigale bwône bwânacizibwe;
bulya Nyakasane ayunjuza duba na buzira kushubira nyuma akanwa kâge omu igulu.
Kandi Izaya àli erhi alêbire, mpu: Acibâga Nyakasane w’Emirhwe arharhulekeraga iburha, singa rhwabîre okwa Sodomo, singa rhwashushire Gomora.
Kurhi rhwaderhaga? Rhuderhe oku abapagani barhashimbaga bushinganyanya bashikîrîre obushinganyanya, bwo bushinganyanya burhenga omu buyêmêre;
Ci bene-Israheli bôhe bakâg’ishimba irhegeko ly’obushinganyanya, ery’irhegeko barhalihikakagakwo.
Carhumire? Bulya barhacîkubagiraga buyêmêre, ci bacîkubagira ebijiro, na ntyo basârhala oku ibuye ly’okusârhaza,
nka kulya biyandisirwe, mpu: Ka murhabwîni oku mpizire omu Siyoni ibuye ly’okusârhaza n’ibuye ly’okuhirimya? Ci oliyêmîre arhankabonesibwa nshonyi.
